subject: Re: Pricing options for 18-month upfront + ramp credits
messages:
From: Ava Shah <ava@elliotapps.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@elliotapps.io
Date: 2025-09-02T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing for long-term up-front plan (12-24mo)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — the latency numbers look great. We're an early-stage startup (Series A, working in fintech compliance) and want a predictable bill as we scale. We are evaluating an up-front payment that would cover 18 months of usage with a ramped minimum for the first 6 months.

High-level ask: can Redwood provide a term that combines an up-front payment with a schedule of ramp credits (to help offset bursty early usage) and a small term discount if we commit 18 months up front?

Attached is a very rough forecast (numbers are monthly token spend estimates). We have procurement questions too (invoice cadence, contract lifecycle, and whether credits can roll month-to-month).

Can you share a short proposal we can present to our CFO?

Thanks,
Ava Shah
Head of Ops | Elliot Apps
[Attachment: ElliotApps_SpendForecast.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Shah <ava@elliotapps.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing for long-term up-front plan (12-24mo)

Hi Ava — great to meet you on the demo call. Appreciate the forecast; that helps a lot.

High level proposal (quick summary):
- Term: 18 months upfront payment with a 6-month ramp window.
- Credits: Provide a pool of "ramp credits" equal to 40% of estimated first-6-month spend to smooth initial bursts. Unused credits roll forward month-to-month within the 18mo term.
- Discount: 8% term discount applied to list unit price for the full 18 months.
- Overage: Post-credit usage billed monthly at the discounted unit price.
- Invoice: One up-front invoice covering committed spend; monthly reconciliations and credit burn statements.

Next steps: if this sounds directionally right I can send a short term sheet and loop in RevOps to confirm how the credits show in billing and the DocuSign flow.

Also copying Ben and Laura for pricing approval and contract questions.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-02T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pricing for long-term up-front plan (Elliot Apps) — quick pricing ask

Ben / Laura — forwarding Ava's forecast and my summary. They're Series A, looking for predictable economics with a small term discount and ramp credits. Proposal below; please flag any constraints from revenue recognition or billing complexity.

Proposal I want to present:
- 18mo upfront commitment, pay up-front
- 8% term discount (applied to committed unit rates)
- Ramp credits = 40% of first 6-month forecast, roll-forward within term
- Overage billed monthly, at discounted rates

Questions for RevOps:
- Is 8% acceptable for this ARR band (~$150k committed ARR)?
- How do we reflect ramp credits on invoices so finance doesn't treat them as refunds (we've done 'credit pools' before but want consistent treatment).
- Can we do a monthly reconciliation statement and a single up-front invoice?

We can do a short-term-sheet PDF once you confirm.

—Tessa
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-03T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing for long-term up-front plan (Elliot Apps) — quick pricing ask

Tessa — thanks for the clear summary. A few notes from RevOps/Legal: 

1) Discount: 8% is within policy for <$250k committed ARR; approve conditional on standard SLAs.
2) Credits: We'll represent "ramp credits" as a pre-paid balance on the customer's account (not a refund). That should be fine for accounting; we'll provide monthly burn reports.
3) Billing: Single upfront invoice works; then monthly reconciliations showing credit burn and any overage invoices.
4) Term: We prefer a clause that unspent credits at the end of the 18 months cannot be refundable, but we can allow a 30-day grace to apply remaining credits to overages.
5) Contract: We'll draft a 2-page term sheet and attach a full T&Cs PDF. Need to confirm any procurement-required PO terms from Ava.

Suggested changes to the customer-facing sheet:
- Move '40% of first-6-month forecast' language to a concrete credit amount (we'll compute based on their attached forecast).
- Add billing cadence and quick escrow language: 'Upfront payment due on signature; monthly reconciliation statement issued on the 5th of each month.'

Once you send the draft I'll do a quick redline and get Legal to sign off.

Thanks — Laura
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Shah <ava@elliotapps.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, procurement@elliotapps.io
Date: 2025-09-05T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed term sheet: 18-month upfront + ramp credits (Redwood)

Hi Ava — attaching a short term sheet and a clean billing summary for your CFO. Key points pulled from our internal review: 

- Term: 18 months, upfront payment on signature.
- Commit: Committed spend = $170,000 (as calculated from your forecast).
- Discount: 8% off list unit price for committed spend.
- Ramp credits: $24,000 (40% of estimated first-6-month spend) seeded to a pre-paid credit pool; credits apply to compute/embedding usage and roll forward monthly within the 18-month term. Unused credits expire at term end, but can be applied during a 30-day grace period.
- Overage: Any usage beyond credits and committed units billed monthly at discounted unit price.
- Invoice flow: Single upfront invoice for the committed amount; monthly reconciliation report and overage invoices if applicable.

Attachments: Redwood_Term_Sheet_v1.pdf (2-page summary) — includes billing examples and a sample DocuSign link. Please confirm whether Elliot Apps needs PO language or alternate invoicing.

If this works directionally I can issue the DocuSign envelope and we can iterate on the SOW/PO details after signature.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if the CFO has questions.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Term_Sheet_v1.pdf (pdf)]
